column3: The all-epsilon error term for maximum Sidon size is much stronger than a construction on selected n; no uniform sharp error mechanism. Literal pair indexing needs source convention, not an ordered-pair wording counterexample.

Infinite complement with every integer represented requires global density control, not a finite covering certificate. Ellipsis and square-domain conventions require primary clarification before proof.
For each r>2 one exponential base must work for every k; factorial bound printed in statement does not provide this. No full-scope shortcut.
All n≥3 is stronger than sufficiently-large-n ordinary-line results; no source check of small exceptions here. Do not count a recollected known theorem as a new proof.
Must determine the infimum and attain it for arbitrary rectifiable curves, plus convex variant; a better cover alone is restricted progress.
Every finite simple graph with Δ+2 colors; bounded-degree or special-family constructions do not close full scope.
Every n and every graph with χ≥n; a few chromatic thresholds do not prove crossing-number comparison uniformly.
Every pair of finite graphs in the Cartesian-product domination inequality; special products give no full-scope route.
Uniqueness for every largest Markov number, not generation of triples or finite search. No uniform uniqueness bridge.
The literal weighted squared error has constants depending only on A over every admissible x,X; not interchangeable with familiar formulations without proof.
Requires first crossing, not the stated known crossing or another upper bound; a small exact certificate is unavailable.
Every c<1 power lower bound is a known-result lead via stronger distinct-distance bounds. Primary successor body not checked, so no verified resolved status or credit asserted.
Record itself explicitly says equivalent Hirsch conjecture is refuted. No discovery from reproducing d-step refutation; primary proof not audited.

Primary Section5 Theorem4 proof and Corollary3 already give n>3k and parity/small-k cases. Remaining parameters not settled by those constructions; no small counterexample pursued. Prior search gives only a restricted n+2 characterization lead, not full bound.
Maximum excess is taken across graphs, while elementary subclass must attain it for each p; definitional existence alone does not prove this. Need primary definitions before treating as tautology.
Exact maximum for every n≥4 needs universal upper bound over simple games. Printed lower bound alone gives no matching argument.
Primary Conjecture2.48 and Remark2.49 checked: k=3 smallest561 and k=4 smallest41041 already source examples; arbitrary k needs global minimality and existence. No new finite instance or theorem.
n≥2d and minimum degree≥d, all d,n. Statement acknowledges known fixed-d large-n and d=1; no promotion of those regimes. General theorem successor needs primary check.
All ranks and ground-set sizes, bound d(n−1) for connected layer multicomplex length. Requires source convention on length and connectedness; no complete combinatorial argument.
Exact largest p-good parameter for every cycle length n≥4; proving goodness for a few p or n does not determine this maximum uniformly.
Every prime p>5 and every positive power exponent; computational ranges, including conditional GRH range, do not prove Olson property. CM-data definition needs primary.
Associating every generator triple must force global associativity in every finite Moufang p-loop for p≠3. Source's p=3 counterexample is excluded; cannot recycle it.
Exact infimum stretch over every degree3 infinite-lattice spanner needs matching universal lower bound. Existing upper construction cannot supply it.
Universal dimension convex-body X-ray bound, not planar case. Potential d=1 wording endpoint is a scope correction, not substantive discovery.
Every simple bipartite planar graph needs induced forest of size≥5n/8; weaker ceiling((4n+3)/7) stated bound does not imply it uniformly.
Any three longest paths in every connected graph must share a vertex, stronger than pairwise intersection. No Helly bridge established.
Every k in3..6, including prior row's three-path case. Stronger conjunction; do not count overlapping k=3 twice or replace common intersection with pairwise.
Every tree must be determined by two degree-associated edge-cards; small-tree/card conventions and reconstruction universe require primary before trivial endpoint objection.
Every n and maximum length of arbitrary 2-increasing triples, not an exponent asymptotic with a constant. Product examples do not prove exact upper bound.
Combined smooth locally uniformly convex global PDE rigidity for n≤9 and nonquadratic existence for n≥10. Singular examples do not meet smooth hypothesis; record's status gloss is not proof.
Every nontrivial even-weight block decomposition and motivic alternating identity, not numerical zeta identities or a special123 case. Missing algebraic definitions prevent cheap proof.
For each fixed k an eventual n0 works for every family size M; n=2,k=16 counterexample printed in statement does not refute eventual assertion.

Primary Conjecture1, numerical examples, Lemma5 proof and Conclusion read. Complete cyclic-autocorrelation proof retained in ordinary-337039.md;180 exact unit checks. Routine finite-sum symmetry; live bounded search not novelty clearance. Zero credit.
Sublinear psi(m) for all m→∞, not on density1 subsequence already reported. Need exact definition of F_Delta and uniform construction.
Infinitely many cyclic orders with weak acyclic matching for every admissible A,B; finite n<23 checks are already source evidence, not infinitude.
One fixed minimum-degree threshold must force Hamiltonicity in every connected balanced forbidden-subgraph graph. Induced versus ordinary forbidden S33 must be read; no wording counterexample.

Primary Theorem18 inductive lower-bound proof, Theorem19 Q3 upper proof and Conjecture20 read. Need universal upper bound for every n≥2; sharp n2,3 instances already published. No computation undertaken.
Every maximizing block graph of every order n≥5 must be a caterpillar; finding one caterpillar maximizer would not prove all maximizers. Small-order checks already source.

Primary Theorem39 strict degree>ceil(n/2) obstruction proof and final Conjecture42 checked; source examples of non-Schur-positive stars do not refute existential floor(n/2). Construct all-n family and Schur expansion still missing.
Infinitely many strict cN*c(N+1)<0 requires source recurrence and sign analysis; reported oscillations alone are finite evidence, and zero coefficients need care.
Record explicitly attributes counterexample to Blanc2009. Arbitrary-characteristic wording does not turn known counterexample into a discovery; primary dependency audit not performed.
Every k≥2 exact largest chromatic number without k consecutive cycle lengths; K(k+1) only yields lower bound. Uniform upper theorem needs source/successor.
Record expressly says false, despite open tag. Reproducing Armstrong-code counterexample has no novelty; no source certificate claimed.
Every strict partition and normalized SchurP Lorentzian property; bounded part/length tests and unnormalized variants do not resolve literal universal statement.
One identity neighborhood per G must avoid every conjugate of every cocompact torsion-free arithmetic lattice. Individual-lattice discreteness is not uniform family discreteness.

Every T>0 largeN heat-kernel free-energy limit, C2 globally and third-derivative jump at pi²; looks like a named phase-transition theorem, but no primary body or normalization checked. No novelty inferred.
Exact Mahler measure equals quarter elliptic L-derivative for specified S4,1;20-digit match does not prove identity. Need primary elliptic normalization and successor proof before computation.
Every real depth r in restriction-distribution equality; definitions D(V), tildeJ and nilpotent distributions are source-dependent. No meaningful cheap equality test without them.
All admissible timelike singularities described in missing item(i), every compactly supported test vector field. Distributional boundary terms cannot be dismissed by smooth Bianchi identity.

One explicit positive c uniform over all quasisimple Lie-type groups, characters and elements; central elements give equality1 not a refutation. Trivial character and g=1 endpoints likewise harmless. Needs primary known-character-bound comparison.
